pages.lesson:
LESSON: EFFECTIVE

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: Story Telling By the end of the sub-strand,  Learners listen to stories and mod
Topic 1.3: Effective

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Effective. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. listen and use talk to organize and clarify thoughts and ideas
2. effectively communicate needs and feelings in a variety of ways
3. listen to concerns and opinions of others and represent them in an appropriate forum e) demonstrate willingness to interact with others f) appreciate the importance of sharing one another’s feelings

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. listen and use talk to organize and clarify thoughts and ideas
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to listen and use talk to organize and clarify thoughts and ideas. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. effectively communicate needs and feelings in a variety of ways
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to effectively communicate needs and feelings in a variety of ways. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. listen to concerns and opinions of others and represent them in an appropriate forum e) demonstrate willingness to interact with others f) appreciate the importance of sharing one another’s feelings
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to listen to concerns and opinions of others and represent them in an appropriate forum e) demonstrate willingness to interact with others f) appreciate the importance of sharing one another’s feelings. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Effective using something you see at school.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Effective.
2. Explain Effective to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Effective.
4. Show that you can: listen and use talk to organize and clarify thoughts and ideas
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Effective. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Effective important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. listen and use talk to organize and clarify thoughts and ideas
2. effectively communicate needs and feelings in a variety of ways
3. listen to concerns and opinions of others and represent them in an appropriate forum e) demonstrate willingness to interact with others f) appreciate the importance of sharing one another’s feelings

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
